Skytruth Analysis
///WEB REPORT/// ON 12 SEPTEMBER AT APPROXIMATELY 1500 HOURS, AS A RESULT OF THE FLOODING OF THE VERDIGRIS RIVER IN JULY OF 2007, I WAS DIRECTED TO INVESTIGATE A POSSIBLE OIL RELEASE NORTH OF COFFEYVILLE, KS. AS I APPROACHED THE SITE IN QUESTION, I NOTICED THREE ORPHAN STORAGE TANKS SETTING APPROXIMATELY 2 METERS SOUTH OF COUNTY ROAD 2200. ALTHOUGH NO OIL WAS OBSERVED, THESE TANKS HAD BROKEN PVC CONNECTIONS AND BROKEN PVC PIPE WAS FOUND THROUGHOUT THE SITE. IT IS POSSIBLE THAT THE TANKS BROKE LOOSE FORM THEIR PERMANENT FACILITY, DISPENSED ANY OIL WITHIN THE TANKS WHILE AFLOAT AND THEN SETTLED IN THIS SPOT AFTER THE FLOOD WATERS WITHDREW FROM THE AREA.

AS I APPROACHED THE SITE IN QUESTION, I NOTICED THREE ORPHAN STORAGE TANKS SETTING APPROXIMATELY 2 METERS SOUTH OF COUNTY ROAD 2200. ALTHOUGH NO OIL WAS OBSERVED, THESE TANKS HAD BROKEN PVC CONNECTIONS AND BROKEN PVC PIPE WAS FOUND THROUGHOUT THE SITE. IT IS POSSIBLE THAT THE TANKS BROKE LOOSE FORM THEIR PERMANENT FACILITY, DISPENSED ANY OIL WITHIN THE TANKS WHILE AFLOAT AND THEN SETTLED IN THIS SPOT AFTER THE FLOOD WATERS WITHDREW FROM THE AREA.

Medium Affected: AIR

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 35.671111, -91.404444 (Explicit)
Report Description
INITIALLY, IT WAS BELIEVED THAT THE SULFUR DIOXIDE (SO2) LBS/HR (UNBIASED) VALUE WAS TO BE USED FOR REPORTING PURPOSES. USING THE SO2 LBS/HR (UNBIASED) VALUES THERE WERE NO EXCESS SO2 EMISSIONS OF OUR AIR PERMIT NOR ANY EXCEEDANCES OF THE CERCLA RQ FOR SO2 (FOR THE PERIOD REFERENCED BELOW). ONCE IT WAS DISCOVERED THAT IT WAS THE SO2 LBS/HR(BIASED) VALUE THAT MUST BE USED FOR REPORTING PURPOSES (AND NOT THE SO2 LBS/HR UNBIASED VALUE) THE INCIDENT WAS REPORTED. THE ENTERGY INDEPENDENCE PLANT (UNIT 2) HAS AN AIR PERMIT (0449-AOP-R7) THAT ALLOWS AN SO2 EMISSION RATE OF 8091 LBS/HR. ON 01/09/12 AT APPROXIMATELY 1300 THE INDEPENDENCE UNIT 2 CONTROL ROOM RECEIVED AN ALARM FOR A HIGH SO2#/HR(BIASED) EMISSION RATE. FROM 01/09/12 1200-1500 (FOR FOUR HOURS) THE PLANT SO2 LBS/HR(BIASED) EMISSION RATES WERE IN EXCESS OF THE PERMITTED LIMIT. FOR THE 24 HOUR PERIOD THE SO2 LBS/HR (BIASED) EMISSION RATES WERE OUTSIDE THE PERMITTED LIMIT A TOTAL OF 923.3 LBS.
